frozen_before: the baseline run of experiment 02; must not change after any baseline or candidate metric is seen (SHA256 in BASELINE_LOCK.json)

review_of_experiment01_contract.kept: inputs/filters, dt from t_lidar, GT-empty frames kept, +-90 deg / 35 m mask, class-first 2-stage Hungarian, center gate (vehicle 2.5 m, pedestrian 1.0 m) OR BEV IoU >= 0.1, ignore-box handling, GT segmentation, map-aligned temporal differencing, scene bootstrap
review_of_experiment01_contract.corrected: box canonicalisation: experiment 01 compared prediction length/width and yaw with GT l/w/yaw literally. GT vehicles have l>=w (100%) but GT pedestrians have l<w (100%) and the V2 output can publish length<width with yaw along the short side (stabilizeMatchedOBB re-fit without long-axis normalisation, CALLGRAPH_AND_RISK_KO.md section 9). All size/yaw metrics of this contract therefore use canonical long=max(l,w), short=min(l,w) and the axis yaw of the long side for BOTH prediction and GT. BEV IoU used for matching is invariant to this relabelling, so matching is unchanged. Experiment-01 style literal metrics are still reported with the prefix legacy_ for continuity, never gated.

inputs.frame_filter: frame-level lidar_primary==1 and has_lidar_npy; GT-empty frames are kept in the input stream
inputs.gt_filter: labels_3d_lidar_v1 rows with correction_valid==1 and vel_source=='raw' (kind=gt)
inputs.ignore_boxes: rows with correction_valid==1 and vel_source!='raw' (kind=ignore): never GT; a prediction matched to one is neither TP nor FP; their points are excluded from split/over-merge attribution
inputs.dt: t_lidar difference of consecutive primary frames; never a fixed 66.7 ms
inputs.pose_inputs: synthetic IMU (yaw = ego.yaw at t_lidar, roll=pitch=0), CAN speed (central difference of t_lidar ego positions), GPS antenna = T_ego2global * GPS lever arm; all stamped t_lidar and fed through the production SensorPoseHistory (identical to experiment 01)
inputs.lidar_ring: the npy point clouds carry only x,y,z,intensity (no ring/time field): ring-based quantities are replaced by elevation-angle bins of 2 deg and azimuth bins of 0.5 deg
inputs.frozen_input_manifest: work/inputs/INPUT_MANIFEST.json (SHA256 of every frames.csv / gt.csv; byte-identical to experiment 01 inputs for 114/114 scenes)
inputs.static_bag: nas_bag_feasibility gt_instance smoke bag (291 scans), replayed in scene form with the /Ego_topic pose because its /imu quaternions are all zero (experiment 01)

system_under_test.path: SensorPoseHistory -> frame_boundary::PrepareScan -> LidarProcess -> FusionProcessAt (no camera input) -> GateInputs/Decide -> BuildV2(kLocal)
system_under_test.launch_profile: Main/main_integration.launch params via roslaunch --dump-params, planner_udp_enabled:=false, harness override imu_yaw_is_true_enu=false (map yaw only, dataset has no lat/lon)
system_under_test.prediction: V2 /lidar/local_object objects (base_link) of every scan whose effective V2 mode includes local; scans without local output contribute no predictions and are counted as dropped
system_under_test.cluster_points: harness --points-out: cluster points of every observed track (tracking input frame) + base_from_input per scan; used ONLY by the evaluator (observability features, split/over-merge attribution with GT, clustering counterfactuals); never by any runtime algorithm
system_under_test.determinism: std::srand(0) per scene process, one process per scene, single-threaded LidarProcess, identical binary flags for every arm

frames.gt: ego/body frame at t_lidar = base_link (verified in experiment 01); GT z is the box center (box bottom ~ -0.35 m in base_link)
frames.temporal_differencing: per-frame residual vectors (pred - gt) are rotated by that frame's ego yaw into map-aligned axes before frame-to-frame differencing; scalar residuals (size, axis-yaw error) are frame invariant

canonicalization.axis_yaw: yaw if l >= w else yaw + pi/2, taken modulo pi
canonicalization.axis_error: e = 0.5*atan2(sin 2(a-b), cos 2(a-b)) in (-pi/2, pi/2]; |e| in [0, 90 deg]

masks.applied_on: BEV center of the box in base_link

tracker_roi_base_link.why: production ROI -30/50/-20/20, z -2/3 in the LiDAR frame (mount 0.8,0,1.45, rpy 0); only the y=+-20 m edges intersect the evaluation mask (x in [0, 28.7] m)

masks.rule: matching uses all GT/ignore boxes and all predictions; afterwards TP/FN are counted only for GT inside the mask, FP only for unmatched predictions inside the mask

stages: stage 1: Hungarian (scipy linear_sum_assignment) over pairs with identical class
stage 2: Hungarian over remaining pairs whose prediction class is unknown
stage 3: remaining predictions are greedily (ascending cost) matched to ignore boxes with the same gate
matching.gate: pair admissible iff BEV center distance <= center_gate_m[gt class] OR (distance < 10 m AND BEV IoU >= 0.1)
matching.tie_break: GT sorted by track_id, predictions sorted by track id before assignment

metrics.recall_precision: recall = TP/(TP+FN) over in-mask GT (overall, vehicle, pedestrian); recall_roi* = GT inside tracker_roi_base_link; precision = TP/(TP+FP) over in-mask predictions
metrics.center_error: BEV distance pred center - GT center for TP: MAE, p95 (all, vehicle, pedestrian)
metrics.size_error: canonical |pred long - gt long|, |pred short - gt short|, |pred h - gt h| for TP: MAE, p95 (vehicle = primary, all reported)
metrics.yaw_error: canonical axis yaw error |e| (deg) for TP: MAE, p95 (vehicle = primary; pedestrian footprint axis is ill-defined, reported only)
metrics.corner_error: nearest-to-sensor corner: the GT corner and the prediction corner closest (BEV) to the sensor position (0.8, 0) in base_link; error = BEV distance between them (m), MAE/p95
metrics.temporal_pairs: pairs (k,k+1) of consecutive input frames (dt <= 0.3 s) where the same GT segment is TP in both
metrics.size_temporal_residual: |(pl-gl)_k+1 - (pl-gl)_k| and |(ps-gs)_k+1 - (ps-gs)_k| (= output size jitter because GT size is constant within a segment): p50/p95; primary = vehicle
metrics.yaw_temporal_residual: |axis_error(e_k+1 - e_k)| with e = canonical axis yaw error (deg): p50/p95; primary = vehicle
metrics.center_temporal_residual: |r_k+1 - r_k| of map-aligned center residual vectors: p50/p95
metrics.corner_temporal_residual: |c_k+1 - c_k| of map-aligned nearest-corner residual vectors: p95
metrics.axis_flip: temporal pair with yaw temporal residual > 60 deg (a 90 deg long/short axis swap appears as ~90 deg)
metrics.extreme_size_jump: temporal pair where long OR short changes by >= 25% of its previous-frame prediction OR by >= 0.75 m: with dpl = pl_k+1 - pl_k and dps = ps_k+1 - ps_k, jump = (|dpl| >= 0.25*pl_k) or (|dpl| >= 0.75) or (|dps| >= 0.25*ps_k) or (|dps| >= 0.75)
metrics.extreme_yaw_jump: vehicle temporal pair with yaw temporal residual > 15 deg
metrics.extreme_size_yaw_jump_rate: fraction of vehicle temporal pairs with extreme_size_jump OR extreme_yaw_jump
metrics.legacy_extreme_jump_rate: experiment-01 definition (center delta > 1 m or vehicle literal yaw delta > 15 deg), reported only
metrics.velocity: experiment-01 definitions (legacy KF absolute velocity of the same track id), reported only: A/B/C/D do not change the KF
metrics.stationary_false_moving: TP with GT speed < 0.2 m/s and kf_init_count >= 2: fraction with predicted speed > 0.5 m/s
metrics.id_switch: per GT segment, consecutive TP observations with different predicted track id; rate = IDSW / TP
metrics.fragmentation: per GT segment, number of TP -> not-TP -> TP interruptions; rate = fragmentations / segments with >=1 TP
metrics.unique_track_ids: distinct predicted ids in local output per scene, summed
metrics.scan_accounting: input scans, scans with local output, dropped scans
metrics.runtime: per-scan lidar_process_ms and frame_ms p50/p95/max, peak RSS per process (dedicated performance run, both arms simultaneously on dedicated cores)

observability.computed_from: cluster points of the predicted track (tracking input frame, sensor at origin) and its raw tracker OBB (harness tracks[].obb); identical for baseline and output-only candidates

features.az_span_deg: max-min azimuth of the points seen from the sensor
features.edge_support: for each of the 4 OBB edges: points within 0.15 m of the edge line and within the edge extent + 0.15 m; supported if >= max(3, 15% of points) and the supporting points cover >= 30% of the edge length
features.visible_faces: number of supported edges among the sensor-facing edges (outer side faces the sensor): 0, 1 (one face) or 2 (two dominant edges / L)
features.fit_residual_m: mean distance of points to the nearest OBB edge
features.inlier_ratio: fraction of points within 0.15 m of the nearest edge
features.pca_ratio: sqrt(lambda1/lambda2) of the XY point covariance
features.obs_count: number of scans in which the predicted id has been observed in local output up to and including this scan
features.prev_miss: the id was observed before but not in the previous scan
features.ambiguity: another observed track's measured point-mean centroid lies within 1.5 m of this track's predicted association position (tracks[].pred) in this scan

split_overmerge.gt_use: evaluator only; never used by any runtime algorithm
split_overmerge.point_assignment: each cluster point (base_link) is assigned exclusively to the GT (kind=gt) box that contains it after expanding by 0.3 m in long/short and 0.3 m in z; if several expanded boxes contain it, the one with the smallest normalised depth max(|u|/(L/2), |v|/(S/2)) wins; points inside an expanded ignore box are discarded
split_overmerge.eligible_gt_observation: in-mask GT with >= 5 assigned points from any prediction
split_overmerge.split: eligible GT with >= 2 predictions each having >= 5 assigned points to it AND >= 50% of their own points assigned to it
split_overmerge.vertical_split: split whose two largest fragments have XY extent overlap (in the GT frame, sides floored at 0.1 m) >= 50% of the smaller and z-interval overlap <= 20% of the smaller height; otherwise horizontal_split
split_overmerge.over_merge: a prediction with >= 5 points and >= 10% of its points assigned to each of >= 2 GT boxes whose un-expanded BEV IoU < 0.1; every such GT observation is flagged
split_overmerge.rates: split_rate = split eligible GT observations / eligible GT observations; over_merge_rate = over-merge-flagged eligible GT observations / eligible GT observations (overall, vehicle, by range and by obs_count of the largest/merged prediction)
split_overmerge.events: maximal runs of consecutive scans of one GT segment with the condition; report event count, frame count and repeated events (run length >= 2)
split_overmerge.review: at least 50 stratified events are rendered (BEV + side view of the points, GT and predicted boxes) and reviewed; the observed false-positive share of the automatic detector is reported

clustering_counterfactual.duplicate_merge_fragments: each observed track's points are re-clustered offline with the production adaptive rule (3D distance <= min(tol(p),tol(q)), tol from horizontal range in the tracking input frame, 0.55/0.85 m over 8..50 m); components >= 2 = a ConsolidateCurrentDetections merge of that many clusters (validated per scan against prof.clusters - prof.det)
clustering_counterfactual.fixed_eps_0p5: same points re-clustered with a fixed 0.5 m tolerance and MinPoints 5: >= 2 components = an object the adaptive tolerance kept together
clustering_counterfactual.interpretation: with the GT point assignment: prevented_split (one GT), avoided_or_caused_over_merge (several GTs)

roi_boundary.event: eligible in-mask GT observation whose GT footprint extends beyond the production tracker ROI (base_link |y| > 20 m for any corner, or top above z 4.45 m)
roi_boundary.effect: TP size/center errors of boundary observations vs non-boundary observations in the same range bucket

sets.development: primary minus holdout (79 scenes) = the only set allowed for configuration selection
sets.highspeed: 30 Lidar_Data/highspeed_eval scenes = crash/drop/large-regression stress only (deskew impossible)
sets.static_bag: static GT smoke bag; reported and gated for jitter/false-moving non-worsening

bootstrap.statistic: paired relative change (candidate - baseline)/baseline of each key metric recomputed on the pooled resampled primary scenes

c_d_justification.C_split_overmerge_recovery: implement ONLY if, on the 79 development scenes of the baseline, (split events + over-merge events of vehicles) >= 100 AND [(split + over-merge flagged eligible vehicle observations) >= 0.5% of eligible vehicle observations OR >= 10% of baseline vehicle extreme size/yaw jump pairs touch a split/over-merge flagged observation]
c_d_justification.D_roi_padding: evaluate ONLY if, on the development scenes, ROI-boundary events of vehicles >= 100 AND [boundary observations >= 0.5% of eligible vehicle observations OR >= 10% of vehicle extreme size/yaw jump pairs touch a boundary observation]
c_d_justification.otherwise: record NOT_JUSTIFIED_BY_CURRENT_DATA and do not implement
c_d_justification.insufficient_vs_not_needed: if the evaluable event count is < 100 the data is insufficient to judge (counts toward PARTIAL_PASS_FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED); if >= 100 events exist but the rate/contamination test fails, the feature is judged not needed (does not block a full PASS)

tuning.set: development (79 scenes) only; holdout, highspeed and the static bag are never used for selection
tuning.eligibility: all metric regression gates below evaluated on the development set (excluding holdout-only and external gates)
tuning.score: primary improvement score = mean of the relative reductions of [vehicle long temporal p95, vehicle short temporal p95, vehicle yaw temporal p95, vehicle extreme size+yaw jump rate]
tuning.selection: per ablation: eligible config with the most improvement criteria met, tie -> highest score; across ablations: the per-ablation winner with the most criteria met then highest score, where B must additionally not worsen dev vehicle center MAE vs A's winner by more than 2% and not worsen dev idsw/fragmentation by more than 2%; only that single selected configuration is run once on the holdout
tuning.after_holdout: no code, threshold, contract or evaluator change

regression_gates.default_false_identical_to_baseline: byte-identical harness jsonl (timing object excluded) and identical points dump on all 114 scenes and the static bag
regression_gates.recall_roi_gates: the same limits also apply to recall_roi, recall_roi_vehicle, recall_roi_pedestrian
regression_gates.highspeed: stress only: new scan drops = 0 and no metric regression gate failing by more than 10% relative / 2 pp

improvement_criteria_on_primary.size: vehicle long temporal p95 AND vehicle short temporal p95 both reduced by >= 15%
improvement_criteria_on_primary.yaw: vehicle yaw temporal p95 reduced by >= 15%
improvement_criteria_on_primary.jump: vehicle extreme size+yaw jump rate reduced by >= 25%
improvement_criteria_on_primary.bootstrap: for every counted criterion (both metrics for size) the paired scene-bootstrap 95% CI of the relative change must lie entirely below 0
improvement_criteria_on_primary.holdout_direction_rule: a counted criterion needs >= 4 of 5 holdout scenes improving in the same direction (size: both long and short p95 improve in that scene); a scene without vehicle temporal pairs counts as not improved
improvement_criteria_on_primary.bucket_no_large_regression: in buckets obs_count 1-5 (first_1_2 and obs_3_5 pooled) and range 15-35 m (15-25 and 25-35 pooled) on primary: none of [center_mae_vehicle, long_mae_vehicle, short_mae_vehicle, yaw_mae_vehicle_deg, vehicle long/short/yaw temporal p95, vehicle extreme size+yaw jump rate] worsens by more than 10% relative and vehicle recall does not drop by more than 2 pp
improvement_criteria_on_primary.static_bag: on the static bag (all GT classes pooled): long temporal p95, short temporal p95, yaw temporal p95 and the stationary false-moving rate of the candidate must each be <= the baseline value
improvement_criteria_on_primary.c_or_d_selected: targeted split/over-merge (C) or ROI-boundary (D) event count must drop by >= 20%

verdict_rules: a large regression in the obs 1-5 or range 15-35 m bucket, a static-bag worsening, or (C/D selected) targeted events reduced by < 20% -> REJECTED_EXPERIMENT
fewer than 2 criteria reach their primary reduction threshold -> REJECTED_EXPERIMENT
>= 2 criteria reach the threshold but fewer than 2 of them also have a bootstrap CI entirely below 0 AND holdout consistency (>= 4/5) -> INCONCLUSIVE
>= 2 criteria fully satisfied and every other condition holds, C/D judged not needed (>= 100 evaluable events) or implemented and passing -> EXPERIMENT_PASS_CANDIDATE_ONLY
as above but C or D could not be judged because its evaluable development events < 100 -> PARTIAL_PASS_FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED
